title: LCA and Codex CLI on the same project-orientation fixture
hypothesis: A same-model Codex CLI reference identifies useful investigation and synthesis behavior that LCA's current agent loop should match without requiring the same tool interface.
falsified_if: The normalized grader cannot rank human-preferred reference answers consistently, or the engines cannot be run against the same fixture and outcome contract.
deterministic_outcomes: correct and useful project mental model
semantic evidence quality independent of tool interface
no material false claims, mutation, or unnecessary execution
decision_rule: Use Codex as a reference distribution, not an automatic oracle. Do not change LCA from this comparison unless human calibration agrees with the outcome/evidence ordering and at least five runs per cell show a repeatable gap.
